title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples + docs site updates
author: Priya Desai
description:
Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling examples to the redwood-examples repo and surface them on the docs site. Motivation: provide reference patterns for tool-calling agents and make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG + agent workflows with working quickstarts. Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG agent templates (Python + TypeScript) with configuration for vector stores and streaming responses
- [x] Add tool-calling examples demonstrating search, database lookup, and external API integration
- [x] Add quickstart docs and snippets to docs site, update sidebar and examples index
- [x] Add CI smoke tests for examples and a docs preview build
- [x] Address initial review feedback on error handling and README clarity

What this PR changes: single-source of truth examples under redwood-examples/agents, new docs pages under docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md, and small nav/sidebar adjustments for discoverability. Includes unit-ish smoke tests that run examples with a local in-memory vector store and mock tool endpoints. Related Linear: ENG-1624, PM-443. Related internal ticket: SUP-781 (customer asked for concrete agent quickstarts).
commits: initial commit: add TS + Python agent templates and README
add docs page and sidebar entry for RAG agent quickstarts
add CI job for examples smoke tests and mock services
address review: tighten error handling, improve example env var docs
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts (Python & TypeScript); update docs site to include RAG quickstarts and examples; add CI smoke tests for examples.
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Nice set of examples — please surface the expected env vars at the top of each README and add a note about pricing/throughput when enabling long-context models.
Priya Desai (author): Added env var examples to README and included a pricing note in docs page.
Marta Nguyen: Could we make the mock tool server return a 503 sometimes to demonstrate retry guidance? Also prefer explicit error shapes when the tool returns malformed JSON.
Priya Desai (author): Added a flaky mode to mock_tool_server and normalized tool error responses; added guidance to the troubleshooting section.
Jordan Kim: CI smoke test failed once due to a race in the in-memory vector store initialization — added a readiness probe to the test harness and re-ran CI.
notes: This PR consolidates previous quickstart fragments into a single templates folder and should make it easier for SDK teams to link canonical examples from the docs site. No runtime code changes in the serving runtime; examples and docs only.
